nodes.name: VIN_5V
nodes.semantic_role: External 5V power rail for analog stage and digital LDO input

nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 LDO. Steps down VIN_5V to VCC_3V3 for the digital section (MCU and DAC).

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: ATmega328P microcontroller. Powered by VCC_3V3 (AVCC, VCC). Controls the DAC via I2C. I2C pull-ups are located in this module.

nodes.name: dac
nodes.description: MCP4725 12-bit DAC. I2C slave to ATmega328P. Powered by VCC_3V3. A0 address pin tied to GND. Outputs an analog voltage to be used as bias/control for the preamplifier.

nodes.name: VOUT
nodes.description: DAC analog output, rail-to-rail (0 to VDD).

nodes.name: VDD
nodes.description: Supply voltage (2.7-5.5V), also serves as DAC reference.

nodes.name: SDA
nodes.description: I2C data, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: SCL
nodes.description: I2C clock, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: A0
nodes.description: I2C address bit. VSS=0x60, VDD=0x61. Must not float.

nodes.name: preamp
nodes.description: NE5532 dual op-amp. Powered by global VIN_5V (VCC_P) and GND (VCC_N) for single-supply operation. Channel 1 is configured as a non-inverting amplifier. DAC_VOUT connects to its non-inverting input network to supply bias/control voltage. Unused channel 2 inputs (IN2_P, IN2_N) are tied to a safe bias state, and OUT2 is left unconnected.
